# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.97

Security maintenance release: both server.exe and rx-db.exe embed Node.js 22.23.4, incorporating the October 21, 2026 security fixes, including CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli memory corruption), DNS/TLS validation fixes and other applicable Node 22 fixes.

Packaging uses pinned @yao-pkg/pkg 6.24.0. Local release validation reads --runtime-info from both actual executables and rejects any embedded Node version other than 22.23.4. Updating a separately installed Node does not patch older NEXT executables.

No new database migration, business-data rewrite or user-interface change. PHP is not used by NEXT. Existing source/dependency findings remain documented in docs/LOCAL_RELEASE_SECURITY_REVIEW.md; this release does not claim to resolve them.

Verify SHA256SUMS.txt. Install through Project Control option 8 then 15, preserve the paired application/database rollback set, and require healthy service version 4.0.0-next.97. Existing guarded migration, fingerprint and recovery checks remain required. Installation is an operator action; publication does not install on a server.

Built and validated locally; LOCAL_VALIDATION.json records the exact source commit, checks and embedded runtime versions. No hosted build is required.

Upstream advisory: https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases

Security dependencies: body-parser 2.4.0 fixes CVE-2026-111181 (compressed request denial of service); ip-address 10.7.4 fixes its parsing denial of service advisory. A disposable HTTP regression checks valid and malformed compressed requests leave the process healthy.
